arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair an anatomical mistake in this exact character portrait; DO NOT redesign the character. The supplied image wrongly contains THREE black-gloved hands: one holding the pen high on the left of the image, one gripping the far-left edge of the sketchbook, and one inserted into a pocket at the waist on the right. The finished woman must have EXACTLY TWO human arms and TWO hands, each connected to the correct shoulder and sleeve. Preserve her approved face, small confident smile, head/eye/chin positions, hairstyle, silver hair, adult body, white coat and ivory dress, jewelry, palette, paint/line style, full portrait crop and the position/shape of the open black sketchbook. Her RIGHT hand is the pen-holding hand on IMAGE LEFT: keep the pen and writing gesture, connect that wrist through a white sleeve to her right arm. Her LEFT arm comes from the shoulder on IMAGE RIGHT, bends at the existing right-side elbow, and its sleeved forearm clearly travels across the FRONT of her waist toward the book's lower right corner; her left black-gloved hand supports the BOTTOM RIGHT EDGE of the open book. Delete the separate hand that grips the FAR LEFT side of the book. Delete the pocket-inserted glove completely; the left sleeve must lead to the actual book-supporting hand instead, with an anatomically sensible wrist, and the pocket should be empty. The book must be physically supported by the left hand, with the right hand free to write. Only redraw the arm/sleeve/hand region needed for this repair. Do not add any extra hand, arm, cuff, pen, book or accessory. True transparent alpha background, no haze, no glow, no painted backdrop, no text. Same 1024x1536 framing.
